en-US.name: Sous-Chef
en-US.summary: Voice-first kitchen assistant powered by FastMCP and PostgreSQL.
en-US.description: Sous-Chef pairs Alexa with an immutable kitchen ledger and Amazon Bedrock to track groceries, eliminate food waste, guide step-by-step cooking, and rescue culinary mishaps.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask Sous-Chef what can I make in 15 minutes?
Alexa, tell Sous-Chef I bought 1 gallon of milk

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Connect via Model Context Protocol (MCP) Streamable HTTP endpoint or local cloudflared tunnel.
